verdict.rationale: The product is a desktop CPU, a hardware component that is not operated through a command interface, so natural-language operation is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack backs this up: control is limited to one-click Precision Boost Overdrive, EXPO and the Ryzen Master tuning GUI. The 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' mention is a developer building block, not natural-language operation of the product, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
